summary: [probe] Untracked derived state remains after the fix: in a fresh `canon init` git repo, editing a scenario and running a reader (`canon gate check`, documented read-only) moves the superseded scenario-index record to .canon/archive/kind=scenario/…, which no managed ignore line covers, so git status shows ?? .canon/archive/.
